clips.send: Someone in their twenties who feels too young or too broke to start sends this to a friend the same age: proof - a 20-year-old travel agent in a one-room apartment built a $175 million company.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says this one was barely out of his teens.

Twenty years old, working as a travel agent, married young, living with his new wife in a single room. He wanted to get rich, so Kevin cleared a few of his energetic blocks.

A few years later, that kid was running a company doing $175 million a year in sales, with a mansion in one of the wealthiest neighborhoods in Yorkshire, England.

Kevin's point: age, money, and connections were never the real obstacle.

What's the one block you'd clear first if you could?
